clauses.falsifier: An independently seeded held-out target cohort has a collision CDF below the preregistered lower prediction beyond its binomial uncertainty interval.
required_controls: same curve and target under negation-only rho

clauses.prediction: Disjoint canonical-y bit windows used for branch routing, distinguished points, and reseeding behave as pseudorandom inputs.
clauses.falsifier: Held-out bit-window, autocorrelation, or branch/DP dependence tests exceed preregistered error thresholds after multiple-test correction.
required_controls: separate curve sizes including full secp256k1

clauses.prediction: Returns to a previously visited orbit state above the explicit short-cycle detector have probability bounded by Lmax^2/(2*N); cycles of length at most 64 are detected.
clauses.falsifier: A verified undetected cycle of length at most 64, or a long-return rate exceeding the preregistered birthday bound at the tested scale.

clauses.prediction: The six-class canonical twist index is uniform and independent of the routing partition.
clauses.falsifier: A held-out contingency test rejects uniformity or independence at the preregistered corrected threshold.

clauses.prediction: Exceptional, cycle, endpoint, and coordinator surcharge indicators have the stated expected rates under the full-work model.
clauses.falsifier: Measured surcharge counts or end-to-end resource costs exceed a preregistered upper bound after confidence and infrastructure accounting.

promotion_rule: No clause is validated by algebraic tests, short smoke runs, or the current BigUint paired benchmark. A result can enter independent review only with frozen protocol, raw held-out observations, control receipts, and explicit scale-transfer analysis. No automatic production claim is made.
